github-evidence.description: Read-only GitHub inventory, repository evidence and routing. It never owns source mutation, execution, physical storage or publication.

development-governance.description: Governed repository planning, isolated source mutation, validation and sealed publication authority. Normal host execution routes through Local Compute; durable artifact/file lifecycle routes through Local Storage.

technology-advisor.description: Evidence-led portfolio and repository-estate discovery, lifecycle classification and deterministic remediation planning. It never mutates repositories; effectful repair remains with Development Studio and its governed execution providers.

local-compute.description: Structured SHA-bound workstation execution, durable local jobs and bounded execution receipts. Preferred durable/heavy authority for command, code, Git, build, test, process, GPU, media and local-model work. It does not replace Local Storage as canonical byte lifecycle authority.

local-storage.description: Canonical workstation/BeeStation byte lifecycle, verified copy/move/zip/unzip, reversible deletion, local logical roots, EVAVO Storage handoff and storage receipts. Physical effects require durable intent and postcondition verification.

automated-testing.description: Browser, responsive, accessibility, performance and governed technical QA campaigns, including control-path and focus-safety regression validation.

computer-agent.description: Browser and native desktop UI interaction fallback. API, logical-storage and structured execution routes are preferred; native desktop control is focus-disruptive escalation and must verify the visible postcondition.

local-ai-agent-gateway.description: Singleton authenticated local ingress for agent control, including governed Local Storage delegation, bounded Windows compute fallback, signed S3 HID, C5 passive telemetry, Comet reachability, hardware-profile acceptance and drift/watchdog state. It never becomes a second byte authority: storage mutations delegate to Local Storage.

network-studio.description: Private LAN/Tailscale/overlay diagnosis, Comet path reachability and network failover health. It does not own KVM input or desktop interaction.

out-of-band-control.description: Acceptance-bound out-of-band/KVM recovery authority. Effectful Comet input, power and virtual-media operations are escalation paths, never routine workstation execution.

super-admin.description: Review, authorization and audit authority for high-impact recovery operations. It cannot self-approve proposals simply because a physical route is technically available.

agent-infrastructure.description: Chat-facing MCP routing, specialist device tools, capability discovery, least-disruptive route selection and remote relay.

brain.description: Bounded historical context, preference intelligence, evidence-backed memory retrieval and the canonical cross-system workstation control operating model.

workstation-manager.description: Canonical workstation, hardware and driver truth; controller lease; exact device transaction assembly; rollback and postcondition verification. It does not directly implement every device protocol.

universal-manipulator.description: Planned canonical device asset, enrollment, connector-manifest, capability-grant and typed-command broker. It is not eligible until its unresolved source is restored, reviewed, configured, transport-online and physically accepted.

forensic-studio.description: Tamper-evident evidence and receipt preservation. It never becomes a remediation or device-control authority.

the-warrior.description: Explicitly authorized, owned-scope security assessment with engagement, target and rate boundaries. It is never an implicit nearby-device scanner.
